comment: Picture 1 is the schematic. The post has two stripboard drawings: the stock 17x15 layout (picture 3, read here) and a larger 19x17 version 'w. recovery stage' with a fourth transistor (picture 5, not read). The Q1 bias resistor is drawn socketed and printed 10K; the legend says 33k for the 2SK44C and 10k for a 2SK30. C2 is an optional cap with no value.
uncertain: 10nF at column 12, rows F-H: printed with a '?' beside it on the part (the trace's value is unconfirmed)
10K socketed resistor at column 4, rows C-E (Q1 bias): printed 10K but the legend says 'Socket 33k resistor to bias Q1, 10k works for 2SK30'
rows: one is the socketed Q1 bias resistor: legend says 33k for 2SK44C, 10k works for 2SK30
value not given; optional cap in case of oscillation, legend suggests 100pF-470pF
